title: Hedgehog motif
subtitle: A flat applique hedgehog with a bobble-spine back, 9 cm
excerpt: The hedgehog motif is a semicircular body with a pointed nose, worked in two parts: a smooth dc belly in a light colour and a dark spine-back with bobble stitches packed across it. The bobbles read as individual spines at 9 cm in DK cotton, and the whole motif sits flat for applique on blankets, pouches, and cushions.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from bobble-texture applique construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 10 (1895), texture stitch applique chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet hedgehog applique in dark brown and cream DK cotton, 9 cm wide, with bobble stitches on the spine back. Photographed flat on natural linen in soft daylight. Recognisable hedgehog profile with pointed nose.

crochet.gaugeText: Each finished hedgehog motif measures 9 cm wide and 6 cm tall in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Hedgehog motif
chartDefinition.caption: Belly: semicircular dc shape worked flat. Spine back: bobble-stitch rows in dark colour worked on top. Nose: small triangle at the pointed end.

glossaryTerms.definition: Five half-finished trebles worked into the same stitch and drawn together at the top, forming a raised bump. Used here to represent hedgehog spines.

content.text: The hedgehog builds a flat semicircular body in cream dc rows from a chain foundation, tapering toward a pointed nose. The spine back is a second panel worked in dark brown with
bobble
stitches every alternate stitch across each row, then sewn onto the upper curve of the body. The contrast of smooth belly and raised spine back reads clearly even at 9 cm.
The bobbles push outward on the wrong side of the spine panel, so work the spine panel with the wrong side facing. When sewn onto the body, the bobbles stand proud from the surface.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 8 g of cream DK cotton (belly), 8 g of dark brown (spine back), 2 g of dark brown (nose). A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors. Black embroidery thread for the eye.

content.text: Gauge
Each finished hedgehog motif measures 9 cm wide and 6 cm tall in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
Stitches used
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st) — UK and US shared.
double crochet (dc) — UK; US "single crochet".
half treble (htr) — UK; US "half double crochet".
bobble (5tr-bob) — five trebles drawn together into one stitch.
Pattern
Belly — cream

Ch 16. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across. (14 dc.) Turn. Row 2: Ch 1. 2dc. Dc to last. 2dc. (16 dc.) Turn. Row 3: Ch 1. Dc across. (16 dc.) Turn. Row 4: Ch 1. Dc2tog. Dc to last 2. Dc2tog. (14 dc.) Turn. Row 5: Ch 1. Dc2tog. Dc to last 2. Dc2tog. (12 dc.) Turn. Row 6 (nose taper): Ch 1. Dc2tog. Dc to last 2. Dc2tog. (10 dc.) Fasten off. Re-join at the narrow (nose) end and work 3 dc, 1htr, 1dc to form a small pointed nose. Fasten off.
Spine back — dark brown

Ch 14. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across. (12 dc.) Turn. Row 2 (with bobbles, wrong side facing): Ch 1. *Dc. Bobble (5tr drawn together).* Repeat 6 times. (6dc, 6 bobbles.) Turn. Row 3: Ch 1. Dc across. (12 dc.) Turn. Row 4: Ch 1. Dc2tog. *Dc. Bobble.* Repeat 4 times. Dc2tog. (4dc, 4 bobbles.) Turn. Row 5: Ch 1. Dc2tog. Dc across. Dc2tog. (8 dc.) Fasten off, leaving a 20 cm tail.
Assembly

Lay the belly flat. Position the spine back along the upper curved edge, bobbles facing up. Sew the spine back onto the belly through the edges, leaving the belly perimeter free for sewing to the base fabric. Embroider a French knot eye near the nose.

definition.title: Hedgehog motif
definition.caption: Belly: 6-row flat shape from 14dc tapering to nose. Spine back: separate bobble-row panel sewn to upper curve.

content.text: Finishing
Weave in all ends. Sew the assembled hedgehog onto the base fabric, stitching around the belly perimeter and anchoring the spine back base row.
Care
Handwash in cool water with mild soap. The bobbles may need light fluffing back into shape after washing. Lay flat to dry.
What to try next

The daisy bobble centre motif (crochet-daisy-bobble-centre) uses the same bobble construction for the flower centre. The pumpkin motif (crochet-themed-pumpkin) uses a similar semicircular body with colour-change panelling.
